candidates.name: Homer City Generation Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: metering and interconnect facility, Burrell Township, Indiana County PA
candidates.to: Homer City Energy Campus power plant, Center Township, Indiana County PA

evidence.note: About 5.8 miles of 30-inch gas pipeline to supply the 4.5 GW gas plant serving the Homer City data center campus; state DEP hearing held May 2026
Pennsylvania DEP public hearing fact sheet for the pipeline permit application (PAD320011)
EQT to be exclusive gas supplier to the Homer City data center campus plant

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Homer City row in roster. About 9.3 km, below the 25 km floor of the 2026-10-02 discovery. Upstream supply is via existing Texas Eastern and Eastern Gas Transmission systems (P0262, P3220), not this line. Applicant is the plant owner, so it is a private lateral.
